notes.title: Bumblebee Studios releases free demo for AI-powered Vaudeville
notes.content:
Attention all gamers and mystery enthusiasts! We are thrilled to announce that our upcoming game, Vaudeville, will be participating in the [b]Steam Mystery Fest[/b] event!

As part of this exciting event, we are offering a [b]free demo [/b]of Vaudeville, which is now available for download on Steam. This demo will allow players to get a sneak peek of the game, which is set in the mysterious world of the 1920s.

[previewyoutube=4Sa653Ac9l4;full][/previewyoutube]

As a detective in Vaudeville, players will be tasked with solving a series of complex murders in a stunningly-realized 1910s-era theatre. The game's [b]AI-powered characters[/b] each have their distinct personalities, backgrounds, and secrets, which players must unravel through careful observation and questioning.

The full version of Vaudeville will be released later this year, but in the meantime, we invite you to try out the demo and experience the thrill of the mystery fest. We can't wait to see you in the world of Vaudeville!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2285800/Vaudeville/
[list]
[*] AI-driven characters with natural language interaction
[*] Open-world investigation
[*] Microphone or keyboard interaction
[*] Playable in VR
[/list]
To bring Vaudeville to life, Bumblebee Studios is also launching a Kickstarter campaign with the goal of raising around $3,000. The funds will be used to finish the development of the game and bring it to market. For more information visit https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/bumblebeestudios/vaudeville-an-ai-driven-whodunit

notes.title: Version 1.0 is live!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1774200/Abeyance

As we promised some weeks ago, we are continuing to develop and improve [b]Abeyance[/b].
Since the launch we have released [b]19 updates[/b] addressing different problems, improved the performance, given a huge facelift to the interface and added some content.
But this is only the beginning! As we said before, we are committed to make [b]Abeyance[/b] a living universe and we plan to keep releasing new content regularly in the form of updates and DLCs, but also new games set in the Abeyance universe. It's gonna be a fun ride! Keep following us.

[previewyoutube=T1xJEHbaAu0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]ABEYANCE VERSION 1.0[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved combat interface.
[*] Improved game stability and performance.
[*] Improved the balance of the game.
[*] Implemented the music player.
[*] Improved user experience and user interface.
[/list]

notes.title: ROADMAP FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF ABEYANCE
notes.content:
Hello and thanks for your interest in [b]ABEYANCE[/b] (or even better, [u]for having bought the game[/u], if you have)! 
We are really proud to have been able to deliver this game to you.
We are a [b]very small studio[/b] and we have been [b]working really hard[/b] to bring the [b]best product[/b] to you, but we are [b]working even harder[/b] to make this game [b]awesome(r)[/b].

[b]ABEYANCE[/b] is a [b]living game[/b] and we plan to release regularly new content in the form of [b]updates[/b] and [b]DLCs[/b].
But [b]ABEYANCE[/b] is not only that, it is also a [b]living universe[/b] in which we plan to keep developing more adventures with different or returning characters, stories and [b]genres[/b] (RTS, RPG, action, sim, ...).
We actually have a [b]wiki[/b] in which we are collecting all the lore surrounding the game, which we will use for inspiration for DLCs and new games. You can find it here: https://abeyancewiki.bumblebee-studios.se/wiki

We hope that you have patience if things may be a little shaky at times in the beginning and that you continue to support us in this exciting adventure. Don't hesitate to contact us at info@bumblebee-studios.se if you have any inquiries or suggestions.

These are the goals for the next updates:

[h3]Version 1.0 (November 2022)[/h3]
[list]
[*]Improving combat [b]interface[/b].
[*]Improving game [b]stability[/b] and [b]performance[/b].
[*]Improving the [b]balance[/b] of the game.
[*]Implementing the [b]music player[/b].
[*]Improving the [b]user experience[/b] and the user interface.
[*]Adding more [b]variation[/b] to armors' look and qualities.
[*]Optimizing for 100% [b]Steam Deck[/b] compatibility.
[/list]

[h3]Januari 2024[/h3]
[list]
[*]ABEYANCE REMASTERED: Revamped version with new graphics, improved game mechanics and enhanced performance.
[*]Release on [b]XBOX[/b].
[/list]

[h3]Q2 2024[/h3]
[*][b]DLC[/b] with new story content and gameplay mechanics.
[*]Support for [b]Steam Workshop[/b] and [b]modding [/b].
[/list]
